notes: Curated swaps, used instantly and as the fallback when Gemma is slow or fails. In 'ratio', the original ingredient is always on the left of '=' (the safety filter checks only the right side). 'contains' uses the allergen ids from allergens.json.

options.name: Flax egg
options.ratio: 1 egg = 1 tbsp ground flaxseed + 3 tbsp water, rested 5 min
options.effect: Binds well; denser crumb, mild nutty taste
options.note: Best in muffins, cookies and quick breads

options.name: Mashed ripe banana
options.ratio: 1 egg = 1/4 cup (about 60 g) mashed banana
options.effect: Moist and sweet; adds banana flavor
options.note: Good in banana bread, pancakes and brownies

options.name: Aquafaba (chickpea liquid)
options.ratio: 1 egg = 3 tbsp aquafaba
options.effect: Light texture; whips like egg whites
options.note: Use the liquid from a can of chickpeas

options.name: Vegetable oil
options.ratio: 1 cup butter = 3/4 cup vegetable oil
options.note: Not for flaky pastry or frosting

options.name: Coconut oil
options.ratio: 1 cup butter = 1 cup coconut oil
options.effect: Firm when cool; slight coconut taste
options.note: Use refined coconut oil for less coconut flavor

options.name: Plant-based butter
options.ratio: 1 cup butter = 1 cup plant-based butter
options.note: Check the label: some brands contain whey, soy or nuts

options.name: Soy milk
options.ratio: 1 cup milk = 1 cup soy milk
options.effect: Closest protein and texture to milk
options.note: Use unsweetened for savory dishes

options.name: Rice milk
options.ratio: 1 cup milk = 1 cup rice milk
options.note: Fine for pancakes and batters

options.name: Oat milk
options.ratio: 1 cup milk = 1 cup oat milk
options.note: Oats can carry gluten unless labeled gluten-free

options.name: Almond milk
options.ratio: 1 cup milk = 1 cup almond milk
options.note: Use unsweetened for savory dishes

options.name: Milk + lemon juice
options.ratio: 1 cup buttermilk = 1 cup milk + 1 tbsp lemon juice or vinegar, rested 5-10 min
options.effect: Tangy and slightly thick, like buttermilk
options.note: Works in pancakes, cakes and fried chicken batter

options.name: Soy milk + vinegar
options.ratio: 1 cup buttermilk = 1 cup soy milk + 1 tbsp vinegar, rested 5-10 min
options.note: Dairy-free option

options.name: Rice milk + lemon juice
options.ratio: 1 cup buttermilk = 1 cup rice milk + 1 tbsp lemon juice, rested 5-10 min
options.note: Dairy- and soy-free option

options.name: Coconut cream
options.ratio: 1 cup cream = 1 cup coconut cream
options.note: Chilled coconut cream can be whipped

options.name: Milk + melted butter
options.ratio: 1 cup cream = 3/4 cup milk + 1/4 cup melted butter
options.note: Will not whip

options.name: Coconut yogurt
options.ratio: 1 cup sour cream = 1 cup coconut yogurt
options.note: Choose plain, unsweetened

options.name: Silken tofu + lemon juice
options.ratio: 1 cup sour cream = 1 cup blended silken tofu + 1 tbsp lemon juice
options.note: Blend until completely smooth

options.name: Plain Greek yogurt
options.ratio: 1 cup sour cream = 1 cup plain Greek yogurt
options.note: For when you just don't have sour cream

options.name: Nutritional yeast
options.ratio: 1/4 cup grated parmesan = 2 tbsp nutritional yeast, then taste
options.effect: Savory, cheesy flavor; does not melt
options.note: Good on pasta and popcorn

options.name: Cashew cheese
options.ratio: 1 cup cheese = 1 cup cashew cheese
options.note: Store-bought or blended soaked cashews

options.name: Gluten-free baking flour
options.ratio: 1 cup flour = 1 cup gluten-free baking flour (1:1 blend)
options.note: Pick a blend that already contains xanthan gum

options.name: Cornstarch (thickening only)
options.ratio: 2 tbsp flour = 1 tbsp cornstarch
options.note: For gravies and sauces, not baking

options.name: Rice flour (coating and frying)
options.ratio: 1 cup flour = 1 cup rice flour
options.note: Not for bread or cake on its own

options.name: Crushed chicharon
options.ratio: 1 cup breadcrumbs = 1 cup crushed chicharon
options.note: Salty, so cut the added salt

options.name: Crushed rice crackers
options.ratio: 1 cup breadcrumbs = 1 cup crushed rice crackers
options.note: Check the label for soy or wheat

options.name: Coconut aminos
options.ratio: 1 tbsp soy sauce = 1 tbsp coconut aminos + a pinch of salt
options.note: Soy- and gluten-free

options.name: Tamari
options.ratio: 1 tbsp soy sauce = 1 tbsp tamari
options.note: Gluten-free soy sauce: helps a gluten allergy, not a soy allergy

options.name: Fish sauce (patis)
options.ratio: 1 tbsp soy sauce = 1/2 tbsp patis
options.effect: Salty and savory, no soy taste
options.note: Use half; patis is stronger

options.name: Salt
options.ratio: 1 tbsp patis = about 1/2 tsp salt
options.note: Add a little mushroom seasoning for depth if you have it

options.name: Coconut aminos + salt
options.ratio: 1 tbsp patis = 1 tbsp coconut aminos + a pinch of salt
options.note: Fish-, soy- and gluten-free

options.name: Soy sauce
options.ratio: 1 tbsp patis = 1 tbsp soy sauce
options.note: Common swap in adobo-style dishes

options.name: Miso paste
options.ratio: 1 tbsp bagoong = 1 tbsp miso paste
options.effect: Salty and savory, no seafood taste
options.note: Add a pinch of salt if it tastes flat

options.name: Mashed tausi (fermented black beans)
options.ratio: 1 tbsp bagoong = 1 tbsp mashed tausi
options.note: Rinse first if very salty

options.name: Salt + mushroom seasoning
options.ratio: 1 tbsp bagoong = 1/4 tsp salt + mushroom seasoning to taste
options.note: Taste and add little by little

options.name: Vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce
options.ratio: 1 tbsp oyster sauce = 1 tbsp vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce
options.note: Usually contains soy and wheat; check the label

options.name: Coconut aminos + sugar
options.ratio: 1 tbsp oyster sauce = 1 tbsp coconut aminos + a pinch of sugar
options.note: Shellfish-, soy- and gluten-free

options.name: Sunflower seed butter
options.ratio: 1 cup peanut butter = 1 cup sunflower seed butter
options.note: Can turn baked goods slightly green with baking soda; this is harmless

options.name: Tahini
options.ratio: 1 cup peanut butter = 1 cup tahini
options.note: Add a little honey or sugar to balance

options.name: Almond butter
options.ratio: 1 cup peanut butter = 1 cup almond butter
options.note: Not for tree nut allergies

options.name: Toasted sunflower seeds
options.ratio: 1 cup nuts = 1 cup toasted sunflower seeds
options.note: Check the label for 'may contain nuts'

options.name: Toasted pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
options.ratio: 1 cup nuts = 1 cup toasted pumpkin seeds
options.note: Good on bread, salads and cookies

options.name: Vegetable oil
options.ratio: 1 tbsp sesame oil = 1 tbsp vegetable oil
options.note: Add a few drops of garlic oil for aroma

options.name: Olive oil
options.ratio: 1 tbsp sesame oil = 1 tbsp olive oil
options.note: Best in dressings

options.name: Baking soda + cream of tartar
options.ratio: 1 tsp baking powder = 1/4 tsp baking soda + 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
options.note: Bake right after mixing

options.name: Baking powder
options.ratio: 1 tsp baking soda = 3 tsp baking powder
options.note: Reduce the salt a little

options.name: Calamansi juice
options.ratio: 1 tbsp lemon juice = 1 tbsp calamansi juice
options.note: Strain out the seeds

options.name: White vinegar
options.ratio: 1 tbsp lemon juice = 1/2 tbsp white vinegar
options.note: Use half; vinegar is sharper

options.name: Calamansi juice
options.ratio: 1 tbsp vinegar = 1 tbsp calamansi juice
options.note: Add near the end of cooking

options.name: Apple cider vinegar
options.ratio: 1 tbsp vinegar = 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
options.note: Good in adobo

options.name: White sugar + molasses
options.ratio: 1 cup brown sugar = 1 cup white sugar + 1 tbsp molasses
options.note: Mix well before using

options.name: White sugar
options.ratio: 1 cup brown sugar = 1 cup white sugar
options.note: Fine in most cooking

options.name: Coconut condensed milk
options.ratio: 1 can condensed milk = 1 can coconut condensed milk
options.note: Dairy-free; works in leche flan

options.name: Coconut milk
options.ratio: 1 cup evaporated milk = 1 cup coconut milk
options.note: Dairy-free

options.name: Reduced regular milk
options.ratio: 1 cup evaporated milk = 2 1/4 cups milk simmered down to 1 cup
options.note: For when you just don't have it

options.name: Potato starch
options.ratio: 1 tbsp cornstarch = 1 tbsp potato starch
options.note: Add near the end; don't boil hard

options.name: All-purpose flour
options.ratio: 1 tbsp cornstarch = 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
options.note: Cook a few minutes to remove the raw taste
